recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban scene featuring a group of young men on bleachers, overlaid with a large, jagged-edged notebook paper collage containing bold, image-filled block lettering and playful, multi-colored secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure anchors the lower half while the collage dominates the upper half.
The notebook paper texture provides a tactile contrast to the photographic background.
Primary colors in the typography echo the casual streetwear of the subjects.
The boombox on the left balances the visual weight of the group on the right.
coreInvariants: Jagged, hand-torn paper edges for the top overlay.
Masked images inside the largest display characters.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central protagonist sits forward in the lower foreground, flanked by three peers and a boombox; the top 40% is occupied by a large graphic header.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central protagonist's direct gaze and the large 'KIDS' block lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large block letters, moves down to the central figure, then sweeps left to the boombox and right to the supporting figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, utilizing dark foliage in the background to make the white paper overlay pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm, sun-drenched neutrals (khaki, skin tones, wood) in the photo.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Crisp white and blue-lined paper texture in the header.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary red, blue, green, and yellow used in typography and masked images.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasts with the slightly desaturated, gritty film look of the photograph.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon; stick to primary school-supply colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and casual marker script.
letterConstructionRules: Display letters are ultra-bold, sans-serif blocks acting as windows for images.
Secondary text uses a rounded, friendly sans-serif with varying colors per word.
Bottom signature uses thick, expressive hand-drawn marker strokes with a heavy outline.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the main title is constructed with sharp, 45-degree angled corners rather than curves.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, masked geometric blocks with loose, vibrant hand-drawn script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for image masking in the display text.
Approximates the playful, school-like feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photo of four young men in streetwear sitting on wooden bleachers outdoors at dusk. A large silver boombox is on the left. The lighting is harsh flash. The top of the image features a white, torn-edged piece of notebook paper with blue horizontal lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large block letters to the center of the paper, masking different portraits inside each letter. Add a line of multi-colored rounded text below it. In the bottom left, add a hand-drawn, yellow-filled name with a thick red outline, tilted slightly.

verificationChecks: Does the paper have a realistic torn-edge texture?
Are the images inside the letters visible and distinct?
Is the bottom-left text styled like a thick permanent marker?
Is the overall color palette reminiscent of school supplies?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the photo
Degree of 'torn' effect on the paper
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the notebook lines are visible through the white paper.
Check that the boombox looks period-appropriate (80s/90s).
Verify the red outline on the bottom text is thick and consistent.
Confirm the vignette doesn't obscure the main subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban photography + Torn notebook paper overlay + Image-masked block type + Primary color accents = Nostalgic Street Collage.
